value: An attack exploiting a previously unknown vulnerability in Huawei enterprise router software caused POST Luxembourg's nationwide telecom outage on 23 July 2025; no CVE or public advisory had been issued ten months later (The Record, 2026-05-19).

Malicious Nx Console 18.95.0, published on 2026-05-18 with a core contributor's GitHub CLI token stolen in the TanStack npm compromise, was live 12:30 to 12:48 UTC on the Visual Studio Marketplace and 12:33 to 13:09 UTC on Open VSX, shipping a multi-channel credential stealer and a Python backdoor (Nx, 2026-05-21).

Five CVEs in Sparx Systems Pro Cloud Server (through 6.1) and Enterprise Architect (through 17.1), CVE-2026-42096 to CVE-2026-42100: unauthenticated SQL execution by omitting the model parameter, unrestricted SQL for low-privileged users, a WebEA race to code execution, client-side authentication and a denial of service; researcher-chained CVSS 4.0 10.0, public proof of concept, no vendor fix at disclosure (CERT Polska, 2026-05-19).

Microsoft's temporary designation for an actor that took over privileged Entra ID accounts through self-service password reset abuse and pursued mass data exfiltration across Microsoft 365 and Azure; no extortion observed and no link to ShinyHunters (Microsoft, 2026-05-18; BleepingComputer, 2026-05-19).

Storm-2949's self-service password reset abuse intrusion: four privileged Entra ID accounts taken over, then App Service publishing profiles, Key Vault secrets, SQL and Storage data, VM Run Command and VMAccess, and ScreenConnect on virtual machines (Microsoft, 2026-05-18).

Linux kernel local privilege escalation turning an RDS zerocopy double-free into a page-cache overwrite of a SUID-root binary through io_uring fixed buffers; public proof of concept by V12 Security (2026-05-19), kernel fix published as CVE-2026-43494 on 2026-05-21; RDS loads by default only on Arch Linux among the distributions V12 tested.

The B1ack's Stash carding marketplace publicly released 4.6M stolen payment-card records in May 2026, its third free-release wave (after 1M in April 2024 and 4M in February 2025); SOCRadar assesses the data likely comes from e-skimming and phishing.

Verizon 2026 DBIR (2025 data, November 2024 to October 2025): vulnerability exploitation overtakes credential abuse as the leading initial-access vector for the first time in 19 years (31% vs 13%); 26% of KEV-listed vulnerabilities fully remediated; median patch time rises from 32 to 43 days; breaches involving a third party rose 60% to 48% of all breaches (Verizon, 2026-05-19).

China-aligned APT active since at least 2022 that moved to European governmental targets in 2025 (Belgium, Italy, Serbia, Poland) with the EchoCreep (Discord) and GraphWorm (Microsoft Graph and OneDrive) backdoors (ESET, 2026-05-20).
